messages:
alex.partner: Quick heads-up: we plan to deprecate the legacy SDK v1 auth header (X-Redwood-API-Key) in 8 weeks. Need to coordinate with marketplace partners and SI integrators. Plan is: soft deprecation banners -> 2-week overlap -> enforcement. Need partner outreach and SDK compatibility checks. :warning:

maria.sdk: Thanks. Which SDKs will be bumped? Semver major for the change?

alex.partner: Yes — v1 -> v2 (semver major). We'll standardize on the HTTP standard header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. No token format change, just canonical header. We'll publish a backward-compat shim for Node/Python for the first 6 weeks.

daniel.sales: We should flag this in marketplace listings and notify partners with high usage. Can partnerships get a usage/partner list to prioritize outreach?

liz.eng: Working on migration helpers. Plan is to include a small shim that maps `X-Redwood-API-Key` -> `Authorization` at request time. Example snippet for Node:```js
// legacy header mapping
if (req.headers['x-redwood-api-key'] && !req.headers['authorization']) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Bearer ${req.headers['x-redwood-api-key']}`
}
```
This will be in the shim package.

priya.ops: Quick Q: are we changing token formats or scopes? Will existing tokens still be valid after enforcement?

alex.partner: No token format or scope changes. Existing tokens remain valid. Enforcement removes acceptance of the old header only.

maria.sdk: I'll prepare a compatibility matrix that maps SDK versions -> supported header behavior -> migration steps. Also propose we bump package major for clarity and add a console warning for one release prior.

daniel.sales: Also need a partner support playbook and a templated email for partners. Suggest a partner-only webinar + FAQ doc.

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: deprecation-banner service scheduled. Soft-warning banners start at 1845600000, enforcement scheduled 8 weeks after that. Automated telemetry will emit metrics tagged `auth.deprecation` for the overlap window.

liz.eng: Note: some marketplace connectors (Azure marketplace, AWS Marketplace listing integrations) use header-based proxies. They may need configuration changes — I'll run an end-to-end test in staging and list any blockers. Pinged @cloud-partners via ticket.

alex.partner: @daniel.sales please collect top 20 partner contacts (by volume + strategic) and I'll schedule a sync. @maria.sdk can you own the SDK docs + deprecation notice?

maria.sdk: On it. I'll publish: public deprecation notice, partner email template, compatibility matrix, and the shim packages (node/python) by EOD Friday. Draft will be in #partnerships-drafts for review.

priya.ops: :thumbsup: I'll prepare rollout playbook, fallback/rollback rules (accept-old-header feature-flagged), and an incident runbook for auth regressions.

daniel.sales: I'll start outreach and draft the webinar agenda. Target: webinar in week 2 of the overlap window, with recording and slides to share.

alex.partner: Great. Action items summary:
- daniel.sales: outreach list + webinar invite (by Tue)
- maria.sdk: compatibility matrix + SDK shim releases (this week)
- liz.eng: test connectors & list blocking configs (this week)
- priya.ops: rollback/fallback runbook + monitoring (by release)
We'll post a formal timeline and the published notice in #partnerships tomorrow. Thanks everyone :seedling:
